title: Equity vs Debt vs Gold Asset Class Comparison
content: Understanding asset classes is foundational to wealth management. 1. Equity: High risk, high potential return (12-15% historical CAGR). Equities represent ownership in businesses and offer long-term capital appreciation and inflation-hedging capabilities. 2. Debt / Fixed Income: Low to moderate risk, steady returns (6-8% p.a.). Includes PPF, bank FDs, and debt mutual funds designed for capital preservation and income stability. 3. Gold: Low correlation with equities, steady store of value (8-10% historical CAGR). Gold acts as a strategic hedge against currency inflation and geopolitical market turbulence.
